ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: International Reporting - Foreign Correspondents in Training. Students will spend spring semester researching the region of Calabria in southern Italy in preparation for an international reporting trip to Calabria, with a stopover in Rome. Under the guidance of Professor Nancy Benson, students in the class will produce a Web travelogue about Calabria and stories for radio and television programs. Journalism 400 required, plus one other required journalism course. Multi-media experience valued. Course Fee: approximately $5,000.00 Maximum Enrollment: 16 Students To Apply : email nbenson@illinois.edu to schedule an interview appointment.
